infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KindMinds uses your GPS position offline to place you on the local survival map and share coordinates with nearby rescuers over Bluetooth.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: KindMinds uses Bluetooth to exchange SOS alerts and messages with nearby phones when mobile networks are down.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KindMinds uses the microphone only when you tap the voice button, to turn your speech into text on this phone. Audio never leaves the device.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: KindMinds keeps your position on the offline map while you navigate to safety.
